Maxsurf Complete

Maxsurf supports hull design, hydrostatics, stability, resistance, motions and vessel performance workflows.

Maxsurf Complete is available in the Vector OS beta. Supported modules, features and host versions depend on your build.

Workflow ideas

Develop a hull form

Use the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended Maxsurf preview, develop a hull form; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Assess stability and resistance

Start from the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended Maxsurf preview, assess stability and resistance; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Review motions and performance

Begin with the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended Maxsurf preview, review motions and performance; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
